title: Changing the advisor, customer, or asset filter recomputes every summary figure immediately, with no reload
refs: specs/wip-work-in-progress.md Story 5 S5-R11; §3 Key Decisions (strip recomputes from visible jobs)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report shows jobs for at least two different advisors, customers, and assets.
custom_steps:
1. Note all seven summary figures.
2. Select one advisor in the Advisor filter and watch the strip.
3. Clear it, then select one customer; then clear and select one asset.
custom_expected:
1. After each filter change, every summary figure recomputes immediately from the jobs still visible, with no page reload and no loading indicator.
2. The recomputed figures reflect only the jobs that pass the filter (across all four tabs together).
